properties.name: user-data-connector.kafka-compact.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of Kafka broker addresses (e.g. {@code localhost:9092}).

properties.name: user-data-connector.kafka-compact.topic
properties.description: Name of the compacted Kafka topic that carries user identity data.

properties.name: user-data-connector.rest-with-delta-kafka.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the REST endpoint that provides the full user identity snapshot (e.g. {@code https://identity-service.example.com}).

properties.name: user-data-connector.rest-with-delta-kafka.data-path
properties.description: Path appended to {@link #baseUrl} for the snapshot endpoint.

properties.name: user-data-connector.rest-with-delta-kafka.delta-kafka-bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of Kafka broker addresses for the delta / delete topic. Falls back to {@code user-data-connector.kafka-compact.bootstrap-servers} when omitted.

properties.name: user-data-connector.rest-with-delta-kafka.delta-kafka-group-id
properties.description: Kafka consumer group identifier for the delta consumer.

properties.name: user-data-connector.rest-with-delta-kafka.delta-kafka-topic
properties.description: Name of the Kafka topic that carries incremental (delta/delete) events.

properties.name: user-data-connector.source-type
properties.description:
Selects the data source that populates the in-memory user identity store.
  • {@code KAFKA_COMPACT} – consume a compacted Kafka topic (key = userId, value = JSON attributes, null value = tombstone/delete).
  • {@code REST_WITH_DELTA_KAFKA} – load a full snapshot from a REST endpoint on startup, then apply incremental updates from a "delta" Kafka topic.
  • {@code WEBHOOK} – expose an HTTP endpoint that receives push notifications from the upstream identity service.

properties.name: user-data-connector.webhook.initial-data-url
properties.description: Optional URL of the REST snapshot endpoint.  When set, the starter performs an initial load from this URL on startup (same format as {@link RestWithDeltaKafkaProperties#getBaseUrl()} + {@link RestWithDeltaKafkaProperties#getDataPath()}). Subsequent updates arrive via webhook pushes.

properties.name: user-data-connector.webhook.path
properties.description: HTTP path on which the starter exposes its webhook endpoint. Defaults to {@code /webhook/user-data}.

properties.name: user-data-connector.webhook.secret
properties.description: Optional shared secret.  When set, every incoming webhook request must include an {@code X-Webhook-Secret} header whose value equals this secret; requests without a valid secret are rejected with {@code 401 Unauthorized}.
